title: Local-to-global covering rigidity for Cayley graphs
exact_target: Does sufficiently large local agreement with a Cayley graph force a global graph covering from it?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000016 (AMR-099-0016). CC BY 4.0.
